content.text: A compact reference that exercises styles, heading levels and several kinds of list.

Each lantern on the quay was numbered, oiled and logged by the keeper before dusk. The orchard on the northern slope produced more pears than the town could eat or trade. The bridge keeper kept a tally of crossings using a string of coloured beads.

Nobody remembered who had painted the clock face blue, but everybody agreed it suited the square. Letters addressed to the old mill were still delivered, although the mill had burned down years ago.
